name: After § 4
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/004 FI/Etelä-Suomi and Helsinki-Uusimaa paper
part_text: 4a. Stresses that ex-post compensation through the EGF cannot be a substitute for policies that ensure affordable energy, reliable access to raw materials, regulatory relief and internationally competitive conditions for European industry; calls on the Commission to assess and disclose the employment and competitiveness effects of Union energy, climate, trade and sanctions policies on energy-intensive and export-oriented industries before proposing further expenditure to compensate for resulting job losses;
